COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Puja in Pithoragarh

Do devotees receive the full spiritual benefit of Puja while attending online from Pithoragarh? expand_more

Yes, absolutely. According to Vedic scriptures, the patron's (Yajman's) Name, Gotra, and Sankalp are paramount. When Pandit Ji invokes your name and gotra before the consecrated sacred fire at Siddhapeeth Nalkheda, the spiritual vibrations and divine fruits reach you directly.

How many days does it take for the Prasad and energized Raksha Sutra to reach Pithoragarh? expand_more

The blessed prasad package is dispatched via India Post (Speed Post) or reliable express courier the very next day after puja completion. Typically, it reaches your postal address in Pithoragarh within 2 to 4 working days.

What are the dakshina and samagri charges for the Puja? expand_more

Dakshina depends on the specific ritual type (Laghu Havan, Samputit Path, or 125,000 Jaap Anushthan) and the number of Vedic Brahmins required. You can call or WhatsApp Pandit Ji directly at +91 87690 84789 for transparent, nominal estimates.

Can Pandit Harshit Sharma travel to Pithoragarh for personal ceremonies? expand_more

Yes. For major events such as Mahayajnas, Griha Pravesh, Shat Chandi Path, or business inaugurations, Pandit Harshit Sharma visits Pithoragarh upon special invitation. Advance booking of at least 10 days is required.
